about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a developer and systems analyst focused on turning real problems into simple, testable and sustainable solutions. I enjoy writing business logic just as much as understanding the data it produces.
about.p2: I work comfortably from requirements gathering to deployment, covering data modelling, APIs, front-end and automation. I value readable code, documented decisions and direct communication with the team.
